description: Submit a check-in for one of the signed-in user's experiments. `answers` maps the experiment's check-in question ids to the user's answers (get the questions from supstack_experiments_get → protocol.checkIn.questions, or supstack_experiment_protocol). On the FINAL check-in the verdict is computed and returned. The check-in number is derived server-side. Requires the user to be signed in (`supstack login`).
name: supstack_experiment_check_in
